name: Hover Pattern Menu
description: Full-screen dark menu with large serif links over a dot pattern and faded photo. Hovering a link dims the others and shifts the pattern and image position.
contents: Vertical list of large menu labels
behavior: Hovering the menu shrinks the pattern and image and dims the non-hovered items
Each item shifts the pattern and image background position
Tapping an item triggers the same state on touch screens
editableByProps: Menu labels, background image, colors, pattern and image sizes, opacities, transition timings

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the pattern and image shift per item

fixed: Loads the Ibarra Real Nova Google font via a link element
Root is full width and full viewport height
Pattern and image positions support up to 4 items
